stories.title: Chester Zoo bans smoking and vaping over wildfire risk
stories.summary: Smoking and vaping are banned across Chester Zoo and its nature reserve from today, with the zoo pointing to dry conditions and the risk of wildfire. stories.title: North Wales Police appeal for witnesses to Holywell car arson
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a car was deliberately set alight on a residential street in Holywell. A black Toyota was set on fire on Strand Walk, near the crossroads with Strand Crescent and Strand Park, shortly after 2am on Saturday 8 August. stories.title: Roadworks round-up: what is closed and where across Deeside and Flintshire this week

stories.title: Countess of Chester Country Park keeps Green Flag Award for ninth year
stories.summary: The country park next to the Countess of Chester Hospital has kept its Green Flag Award for a ninth consecutive year.
